title: Welcome to Braisgf.dev — A Fullstack Dev’s Personal Lab, Blog & Playground 🧪🌐
content:
Hey there, internet wanderer! 👋

Are you into **fullstack development**, **indie game dev**, or **tech projects powered by Raspberry Pi**? Then you're in the right place.

I'm Brais — developer, maker, digital storyteller. After years building apps, robots, APIs, and weird projects, I created **braisgf.dev** as my ultimate personal lab.

## What is braisgf.dev?

This site is more than a portfolio:

- 🧪 A **Digital Lab** for experiments in web dev, Unity, electronics, AI and more.
- 🧠 A **Blog** where I share dev logs, tutorials, behind-the-scenes and rants.
- 🕹️ A **Playground** with a retro hacker console vibe, some Easter eggs, and a lot of personality.

## Built on My Own Stack

This entire website is self-hosted on a **Raspberry Pi 5**, running NGINX and HTML+JS. No templates. No CMS. Just me and my code.

## What You'll Find Here
- Tech projects from concept to release
- Tools and experiments (games, apps, bots)
- Fullstack developer insights (React, Node, MongoDB, AWS...)
- Maker content: soldering, 3D printing, Raspberry Pi stuff
- Blog articles on learning, curiosity, and failing better

## Let’s Connect
If you love building cool stuff too, or you’re just curious, check out the [lab 🧪](/lab), read the [blog 📖](/blog), or hit me up on [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/braisgf) or [GitHub](https://github.com/thebraisgf).

✨ Welcome to the playground. Let’s imagine, build, and share together.

— Brais
